course_name_en: KMM3611 — Quality Control in Chemical Industry

learning_outcomes.text: Students will learn quality control concepts, statistical methods, and theoretical principles and applications specific to chemical engineering and production processes.
Students will learn to independently research and interpret current trends and standards in quality management such as Industry 4.0, sustainability, EFQM Excellence Model, and calibration.

Students will learn to systematically analyze and prepare a technical report covering input (incoming material), process, and output (final product) quality control stages of a chemical production process.

Students will learn to effectively communicate quality control scenarios and proposed solutions for complex chemical processes to the target audience using technical language and an oral presentation style.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Quality Control Concept and Sustainability
Basic Concepts of Quality Control and Lean Production
Fundamental Elements of Quality (Components of Quality)
Objectives of Quality Control and Influencing Factors
Total Quality Control and its Stages
Frequency Distributions and their Evaluation, Probability and Probability Distributions
bibliography: Lipson, C., Sheth, N.J., Statistical Design and Analysis of Engineering Experiments. McGraw Hill Book Co., New York, 1973
Montgomery, D.C., Runger, G.C., Hubele, N.F., Engineering Statistics, 2nd ed., John Wiley and Sons, Inc., New York, 2001.
Haldar A., Mahadevan, S., Probability, Reliability and Statistical Methods in Engineering Design, John Wiley& Sons., 2000.
